get.summary: Change feed: every public write in commit order, as `(seq, entity_type, entity_id, op, at)`.
get.description:
`seq` is global and strictly increasing. Page with `after=<next_after>` (default 0,
`limit` default 50, max 500) until `items` is empty. Entity types: `place`, `section`,
`menu_item`, `dish`, `observation`, `fact` (id `<scope>:<id>|<property>`), `menu`
(pre-built menu of a place), `vendor_binding`, `key` (published keys), `registry` and
others added later;
ignore unknown types. Re-fetch the entity to get its new state.

Cheap by design: one index-only range scan on `seq` with a limit. To start, load the
latest snapshot from `GET /v1/export` and continue from `after=<changes_seq>`.

200.description: The document. Cacheable; weak `ETag` from the change sequence.

301.description: The record was merged; follow `Location` to the survivor.

get.summary: Manifest of the latest public snapshot.
get.description:
Snapshots are written daily (and on demand with `eatsights export`) from one
consistent database snapshot. They contain public data only: places, sections,
menu_items, dishes, observations (public form), facts, vendor_of attestations
and the registry, as gzip NDJSON, CC0-1.0.

**Bootstrap a local copy:**
1. `GET /v1/export`; remember `changes_seq`.
2. Download every `files[].url` and check its `sha256`; load the NDJSON lines.
3. Follow `GET /v1/changes?after=<changes_seq>` and keep paging with
`after=<next_after>` until `items` is empty; re-fetch each changed entity.
The snapshot already contains everything up to and including `changes_seq`.

200.description: The latest snapshot's manifest.

get.summary:
One file of the latest snapshot, e.g. `places.ndjson.gz` (or just `places`).
Served as `application/gzip`; `ETag` is the file's SHA-256.

200.description: The file, gzip NDJSON. Its `ETag` is the SHA-256 listed in the manifest.

get.summary:
One file of a specific snapshot, as linked from the manifest (`files[].url`).
Immutable: cache it forever. Returns 404 once the snapshot is pruned (the newest
few are kept); start again from `GET /v1/export`.

200.description: The file, gzip NDJSON. Its `ETag` is the SHA-256 listed in the manifest.

post.summary:
Merges. `action: "merge"` with params `entity_type` (`place` default, or `menu_item`)
and either `a_id` + `b_id` or `suggestion_id`; optional `survivor_id` (default: the
OSM-linked record, else the older). `action: "unmerge"` with `entity_type`, `id`.
`action: "dismiss"` with `suggestion_id`. Nothing is deleted.

200.description: Applied (or already applied).

post.summary:
Legal or safety removal of an observation (`action: "remove_observation"`, params
`observation_id`, `reason`: `legal` or `safety`). The content is replaced by a
tombstone; the public removal log holds only the id and the reason code.

200.description: Applied (or already applied).

status.description: `accepted` or `duplicate` (the same signed object was applied before).
